summary.en: Conan instantly realizes that the incident makes the appraisal session later than usual is actually a set up made by Kid, and Kid is now disguised as one of the three person, but who could he disguise as? After Karino's suspicion is resolved, Andou discloses about Karino’s wider leg size (to which the other two denies) and Chuujou’s hat being different as it has been turned upside down to hide the ketchup. Conan then figures out the missing crown mystery, but he couldn’t figure out how Kid is gonna escape with the crown.
summary.zhHans: 怪盗基德相关作品以预告、变装、宝石目标和柯南的追踪对决为核心，属于独立角色专题线。
